context: Sho-young helps Hiroshi-elder set up a new smartphone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: This phone is really something, isn't it…
lines.style: Slow, measured Kansai drawl. Warm puzzlement in the opening. Honest, patient admission of confusion — not frustrated, just genuinely uncertain. Slight trailing-off on the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、画面押すだけ。
lines.en: Grandpa, you just press the screen.
lines.style: Gentle, reassuring tone without a hint of condescension. Quiet confidence in his knowledge. Simple, clear instruction delivered with natural warmth — not lecturing, just helping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Soft, seeking confirmation without anxiety. A small lift of hope at the end — tentative but trusting. The voice of someone willing to learn, checking in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、操作、慣れたら簡単やで。
lines.en: Yeah, it gets easy once you're used to it.
lines.style: Warm reassurance with quiet conviction. Matter-of-fact but kind — not dismissing the difficulty, just steady belief it'll click. Kansai lilt settling in naturally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: I'll leave the setup to you then.
lines.style: Soft, deliberate delegation. The release of a weight — trusting, not surrendering. Warm acceptance that this young person knows what to do. Slight Kansai rhythm at the close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 俺がやっとくから、安心して。
lines.en: Don't worry, I'll take care of it.
lines.style: Bright, capable assurance. Quick and genuine without boasting. The confidence of someone young who actually knows this territory. Warm and steadying.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: おおきに、頼もしいなぁ。
lines.style: Tender warmth with genuine pride underneath. Slow, affectionate Kansai cadence. The words of an elder who doesn't praise carelessly, fully meaning it. Soft, almost marveling at the boy.
